## Change

Describe what the change does.

## Reason

Describe why the change is necessary. Add `Closes #<number>` if it closes an issue.

## Check

- [ ] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run ty check`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uv run marimo check app.py --select MW`
- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit.
